offers_products.reason: Produces fuel ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil at its Lamberton, Minnesota plant.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling ethanol and co-products; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells ethanol, distillers grains and corn oil to marketers, blenders and feed buyers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Ethanol sold via marketers to refiners and blenders; distillers grains to feed customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Commodity ethanol and distillers grains are sold continuously through marketing agreements with repeat buyers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fuel ethanol is blended into gasoline under mandates, and demand is steady, though margins swing with commodity prices.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent bulk commodity shipments of ethanol and feed; not infrequent large purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured ethanol and co-products, produced by a plant.

large_customers.reason: Ethanol goes through large marketers to oil refiners and blenders; the buyers are large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs a capital-intensive ethanol plant with rail and storage infrastructure.

notes: Website text is mostly commodity quotes; the business description comes from general knowledge of the plant.
